statement: Implement one function to a written specification, confined to one named file; the project's existing tests for it are the gate.

cases.source: controlled (a tested function of the project removed at the pinned commit)
cases.instruction:
Implement the function `shortenTitle` in src/domain/text.ts. Its body has been removed and currently throws. Keep its signature and everything else in the file exactly as it is.

Specification: Return the display form of a title: at most `max` Unicode code points (count code points with Array.from, never split a surrogate pair). A title of at most `max` code points is returned unchanged. A longer title becomes a prefix followed by the single character "…" (U+2026), together at most `max` code points: take the first max-1 code points; when the code point right after them (index max-1) is not whitespace the cut would split a word, so cut back to the last whitespace inside those max-1 code points, if there is one at an index greater than 0; remove trailing whitespace from what is kept; if that leaves nothing, keep the first max-1 code points with trailing whitespace removed instead.

cases.instruction:
Implement the function `correctionDetails` in src/domain/gate.ts. Its body has been removed and currently throws. Keep its signature and everything else in the file exactly as it is.

Specification: Build the text handed to the Builder for a correction, as lines joined with "
". First one line "- <reason>" per entry of ev.reasons. Then, for every criterion of criteriaFromGate(ev) whose status is not "verified", the line "- <subject> (<where>): <status><detail>", where <where> is "regression of an earlier task" for a regression criterion and its check otherwise, <status> is the status with its first "_" replaced by a space, and <detail> is " - " followed by the trimmed detail cut to 600 characters (omitted when the detail is empty). Then, when ev.verdict is "FAIL:CHECK" and ev.checks.check_stage is a non-empty string, the line "Check stage output (tail):
" followed by the last 3000 characters of stripAnsi of that string. Then, when ev.verdict is "FAIL:BUILD" and ev.checks.build.log_tail is set, the line "Build output (tail):
" followed by the last 3000 characters of stripAnsi of it. When there is no line at all, return "(the gate gave no further detail)".

cases.instruction:
Implement the function `qualification` in src/domain/router.ts. Its body has been removed and currently throws. Keep its signature and everything else in the file exactly as it is.

Specification: Qualification of one worker for one task class, from recorded evidence only. Consider the records of that worker and task class whose `agree` is not null. With none, return { status: "unqualified", samples: 0, agreement: null }. Otherwise samples is their number and agreement is the share of them with agree === true AND valid === true. With fewer than QUALIFY.minSamples samples the status is "shadow"; otherwise "qualified" when agreement >= QUALIFY.minAgreement, "rejected" when agreement < QUALIFY.rejectBelow, and "shadow" in between. Always return { status, samples, agreement }.

cases.instruction:
Implement the function `classifyShape` in src/domain/plan.ts. Its body has been removed and currently throws. Keep its signature and everything else in the file exactly as it is.

Specification: Classify a contract as "atomic" or "complex" by fixed rules over its must-criteria (priority === "must"); collect a reason string per rule that applies, in this order, and return { shape: "complex" when at least one reason applies, otherwise "atomic", reasons }. Rule 1: more than CALIBRATION.maxMustCriteriaAtomic must-criteria -> `rule 1: ${n} must-criteria (more than ${CALIBRATION.maxMustCriteriaAtomic})`. Rule 2: every must-criterion has a group and there are at least 2 distinct non-blank groups -> `rule 2: ${count} independent deliverables (${the distinct groups, sorted, joined with ", "})`. Rule 3: at least one must-criterion is tagged "migration" and some must-criterion of type "behavior" is not tagged "migration" -> "rule 3: a data migration and user-visible behaviour that depends on it". Rule 4: at least one must-criterion is tagged "interface-change" and some must-criterion is not -> "rule 4: changes an interface accepted contracts depend on and adds new behaviour on top". Rule 5: f.budgetExhausted is true -> "rule 5: an atomic attempt exhausted its correction budget".

cases.instruction:
Implement the function `rankFiles` in src/domain/context.ts. Its body has been removed and currently throws. Keep its signature and everything else in the file exactly as it is.

Specification: Rank the files found by a context scan. scan.hits maps each search term to its hits ({ file, line, text }); a missing hits object counts as empty. A file's score is the number of distinct terms in which it appears at least once. A file's penalty is 1 when it is a test file (its path matches /(^|\/)(tests?|__tests__)\/|\.test\.|\.spec\./) plus 1 when it ends with .md, .json, .lock, .sql or .snap. Order the files by penalty ascending, then score descending, then path ascending (localeCompare), and return at most CONTEXT_BUDGET.maxFiles paths.

Implement the function `gateScope` in src/domain/plan.ts. Its body has been removed and currently throws. Keep its signature and everything else in the file exactly as it is.

Specification: Which requirement ids the gate requires for a branch of a planned contract, or null for "the whole contract". Return null when there is no plan, the plan has no tasks, or `integrated` is true. Plan task ids look like "T9.a": a task's entry name is the part after the dot. Return null when `entry` is not null and no task has that entry name. Otherwise return the sorted, de-duplicated union of the `covers` of the tasks named in `mergedEntries` and, when `entry` is not null, of the task named `entry` (entry names that match no task contribute nothing).

cases.instruction:
Implement the function `partialMergeDecision` in src/domain/plan.ts. Its body has been removed and currently throws. Keep its signature and everything else in the file exactly as it is.

Specification: Decide what happens to already merged plan tasks when a contract is revised. If any of the facts mergedTasksSelfContained, mainHealthy, conflictsWithRevisedContract, onlyServesAbandonedOutcome is null (checked in this order): { decision: "NEEDS_OWNER", reasons: one `cannot be established: ${fact name}` per null fact }. Otherwise collect problems in this order: not mergedTasksSelfContained -> "a requirement is left half-delivered"; not mainHealthy -> "main is not healthy"; conflictsWithRevisedContract -> "conflicts with the revised contract"; onlyServesAbandonedOutcome -> "exists only for the abandoned outcome". No problem: { decision: "KEEP", reasons: ["independently valid; main healthy; consistent with the contract"] }. With problems: when laterWorkDependsOnIt === false and revertPassesGate === true: { decision: "REVERT", reasons: the problems }; otherwise { decision: "NEEDS_OWNER", reasons: the problems plus one more: "later accepted work depends on it" when laterWorkDependsOnIt is truthy, else "a safe revert could not be established" }.
